name: Alien Dawn
description:
At night, both water and carbon dioxide freeze in the upper atmosphere, such that every dawn is accompanied by a procession of colorful haloes over the horizon.
<color_c_dark_gray>  - Salus IV rediscovery report 02.11.2428, submitted by Cpt.  Jean McAllister.

requirements.description: Wake up after a night on Salus IV.

name: Force Shutdown
description: Lets not turn it back on again.

requirements.description: Destroy a robot from the Late Hyperspace Age.

name: Public Enemy
decription: You have managed to anger the minor players of Salus to such extent that one thing they can agree on is that you need to be put down.  Good job.

name: The Usual
description: Even if the air's poison, the agrav's down and the streets swarm with violence, the spacer's row is open.  We are all dead if it isn't.

name: Flatline
description: You link up and spin up the proxy ney, head full of dreams and heart full of stims.  Punch straight to the corporate adress, eyes wide as dinnerplates, too wide, too far, and too fast. You fry before you can even think. Zeroed in a cheap capsule stat off the orbit of Rhea. You just weren't good enough. No one is.

I've seen how they look at us, out of the holoscreens and in their chambers of law.  Like we're animals, or worse, machines.  They don't think of us as at all.
<color_c_dark_gray>  - I.  Evidence locker 237-B Imenar section, UICA archive MI-45.

Mostly, it makes me feel very small, like when I was a kid playing with my father's tools.
<color_c_dark_gray>  - "Life in the Tenellus Frontier", interview with mercenary captain, c2514.

requirements.description: Wield a weapon from the Late Hyperspace Age.

description:
Now just watch this!  [STATIC]
<color_c_dark_gray>  - unattributed comms chatter from raid on UFS Golden Sunray.

Planet crosses into a giant scrapfield every few months, some old battlefield from when the discontinuity happened.  Locals make a great show of it, marks the start of the great hunt.
<color_c_dark_gray>  -"The Highlands of Aztlan" holodoc

We had those at home too, on summer days we'd chase frogs through the pipes and into the coolant chambers deep below them.  I remember the em-lights still glittering in the immense halls, it was like a secret night sky sealed away.
<color_c_dark_gray>  - overheard in Port Augustmoon.

I try not to think about what it actually means, none of us do really.  Otherwise it would drive us mad with grief.  [Laughs] Still drives some mad though, I guess.
<color_c_dark_gray>  - "Life in the Tenellus Frontier", interview with salvor guild journeyman, c2514.

requirements.description: Receive 2500 damage in a single attack and survive (optional).

description:
Unexplained, instinctual urges might rarely manifest after bio-modification.  In such cases we recommend the following self-centering techniques…
<color_c_dark_gray>  - Aftercare brochure, Mercurial Genomics ltd.

requirements.description: Cross a threshold using genetech templates.

description:
There were among our men those who asked whether it was all not a dream.  How else could one explain the glimpse of things never heard of, never seen, and never even conceived of before.
<color_c_dark_gray>  - recovered from the log of ESS Firebird.

name: Escape from the Island of Dr. Moreau
